Their homes are smaller (even the wealthy) and frequently their refrigerators are tiny (dorm sized to us) and many kitchens are arranged for their cooks to use, not the owners (this is in Asia). They don’t understand that on any given weekend, with a few hours notice, people in the US suburbs will invite 20 people to their home for a BBQ.  For major and minor holidays, people will host 50+ guests (suburban people).  We also have enormous group activities like church meals, reunions, scouting and children’s sports events.  You can be asked to bring Gatorade for 30 kids, cook a dish for 50, and so on.  Those super large packages (like 5 gallon pickles) are aimed at this market.
